original: あ〜退屈。\n退屈退屈、退屈〜〜！
traducao: Aah, so bored.\nBored, bored, sooo bored~~!

original: うるせーな。\nでかい声で騒ぐんじゃねえ！
traducao: Shut up, will ya?!\nStop screeching at the top of your lungs!

original: 耳がつぶれるっつーの
traducao: You're gonna break my eardrums!

original: ほっほ〜〜？
traducao: Ohooo~~?

original: ちょっとあんた。\n言ってくれんじゃないの
traducao: Listen here, you.\nYou've got some nerve, don'tcha?!

original: つか、そういうお前が\n一番うるせェんだよ
traducao: Besides, you're the one\nbeing the damn noisiest here,

original: この腹出しトサカ
traducao: you belly-baring rooster head.

original: 誰に向かって\n口きいてんだぁ！？
traducao: Who the hell do you think\nyou're talking to, huh?!

original: てめェ以外に誰がいんだよ！？\nあぁ？
traducao: Who else would I be talkin' to?!\nHuh?!

original: ったく、何揉めてやがんだ。\nちょっとは落ち着……
traducao: Good grief, what're you fighting over?\nCalm down a little, both of...

original: デコ野郎はすっこんでな！
traducao: Back off, Forehead Boy!

original: およびじゃないってのよ！
traducao: Nobody called for you, butt out!

original: てめえら……人が親切に\n止めに入ってやってりゃ……！
traducao: You brats...... Here I am trying\nto break it up, and you......!

original: ……ここは不良のたまり場なの？
traducao: ......Is this a hangout for delinquents?

original: おい、何か落ちてるぞ、しかし
traducao: Hey, someone dropped something, yes-yes!

original: あ、ほんとだ、メガネが落ちてるよ。\n誰の落し物だろうね？
traducao: Ah, you're right, a pair of glasses.\nI wonder who dropped them?

original: メガネを落としてそのままでいられるなんて\nルカみたいな、とんだおバカさんね
traducao: Dropping glasses and not even noticing...\nMust be a huge airhead like Ruca.

original: い、いくら、僕だって、メガネ落としたら\n気付くよ、多分……
traducao: E-Even I would notice if I dropped\nmy glasses, probably......

original: そうだ、ルカ！\nあんた、このメガネ掛けてみなさいよ
traducao: Oh, I know, Ruca!\nWhy don't you try putting them on?

original: 少しは頭が良く見えるんじゃない？
traducao: Maybe you'll look a little smarter!

original: ダ、ダメだよ、そんなの。\n落とした人に悪いよ……
traducao: N-No way, that's terrible.\nI'd feel bad for whoever lost them...

original: ごちゃごちゃうるさいわねー。\n掛けなさいっつったら、掛けるのよ！
traducao: Stop whining, you nuisance!\nWhen I say put them on, put them on!

original: あら、案外似合うじゃない！
traducao: My, they actually suit you quite well!

original: でも、お坊ちゃまぶりに\n余計拍車が掛かったかしら〜？
traducao: Though you look even more\nlike a sheltered rich kid now~

original: 案外似合うとは、随分な言い方ですねぇ
traducao: Saying they 'actually suit me' is rude.

original: メガネが必要無い方の\n「らしい」意見ではありますが
traducao: Quite typical of someone\nwith no need for glasses, however.

original: ちょ、ちょっとルカ？\nその口調、どうしちゃったの？
traducao: H-Hold on, Ruca?\nWhat is with that tone of voice?!

original: 別に、いつもと\n何ら変わりはありませんが
traducao: I don't believe I am speaking\nany differently than usual.

original: 何か？
traducao: Is something the matter?

original: ちょっと、コーダ。\nこれ一体どういうこと？
traducao: Hey, Coda.\nWhat on earth is going on here?!

original: コーダも、わからないぞ、しかし
traducao: Coda doesn't know either, yes-yes!

original: おや。　こそこそと、私の噂話ですか？\nいや〜、困りますねぇ。\n本人を目の前にして
traducao: My now. Whispering rumors about me?\nDear me, how troublesome,\nwith the subject right before you.

original: き、き、気持ち悪ーーーーい！！！！！
traducao: Cr-Cr-Creeeeepy--!!!!!

original: コ、コーダを、置いていくな、しかし！
traducao: D-Don't leave Coda behind, yes-yes!

original: なるほど。\n今度は置き去りですか。\nこれはなかなか、楽しみ甲斐がありますねぇ
traducao: I see.\nAbandoning me this time, are you?\nThis promises to be quite entertaining.

original: おや、ここもハズレですか。\n困りましたねぇ〜
traducao: My, another miss here as well?\nHow terribly troublesome~

original: 仕方ありません。\n本国に申請して、\nスペアのメガネを取り寄せますか
traducao: It cannot be helped.\nI shall petition the empire to send\na spare pair of glasses.

original: どこに忘れて来たんですかねえ。\n歳はとりたくないですね
traducao: Where could I have left them?\nOne truly hates to grow old.

original: あ〜〜暑いぃ……。\nクレス、どうにかして
traducao: Aah, it's so hot......\nCress, do something!

original: ほんっと今すぐ！\nどうにか！\n死んじゃう！！
traducao: Right this second!\nDo something!\nI'm gonna die!!

original: わかったわかった。\n仕方ないなぁ
traducao: Alright, alright.\nI guess I have no choice.

original: へっ？\n何かいい案でもあるの！？
traducao: Huh?\nYou have a good idea?!

original: ごほん
traducao: *cough*

original: イリアは、そのままそうして\nイリアいい
traducao: Iria, stay as you 'are-ia',\nand you'll be fine!

original: 寒ッ！？\nやだ、何今の寒、寒〜〜ッ！！
traducao: BRRR?!\nGross, what was that?! So cooold!!

original: ちょ……確かによく言われるから\nやってみたけど、そんなに……？
traducao: Wait... People told me that often,\nso I tried it, but was it that bad...?

original: そういえばイリアって\n学校建てたいんだっけ？
traducao: Come to think of it, Iria,\nyou want to build a school, right?

original: ね、もう具体的に構想は固まってるの？
traducao: Do you have a concrete plan in place?

original: ん〜まぁ、大体の感じはね〜
traducao: Mmm, well, roughly, yeah~

original: 費用・規模・必要人員……\nその他設立にかかる諸々の時間と手間！
traducao: Cost, scale, required personnel...\nPlus the time and labor to found it!

original: 今の時点で考えられるものについては\nキチンと数字にしてるかな〜
traducao: Everything I can think of right now\nis properly calculated in numbers~

original: さっすが。\nやるじゃない！\nって事は……
traducao: Impressive.\nNot bad at all!\nWhich means......

original: もうアタリ付けてるの？\n「あっち」の方は
traducao: Do you already have targets in mind\nfor 'that' side of things?

original: ニシシシシシ！\nモチのロンですわよ〜ルーティの奥様
traducao: Nishishishi!\nAbso-lutely, Madame Rutee~

original: エステル、ウッドロウ、ナタリアを始め、\n船内の金持ち要員にはジワジワと\n根回ししておりますわ。　キヒヒヒヒ！
traducao: Starting with Estelle, Woodrow, Natalia,\nI've been softening up all the rich folk\naboard this ship! Kihihihi!

original: 万事ぬかりないってワケね
traducao: Nothing left to chance, I see.

original: 前から思ってたけど……。\nイリアって、やる事わかってるわよねぇ
traducao: I've thought this for a while, but...\nyou know what you're doing, Iria.

original: 嫌いじゃないわよ、そういう風に\nハッキリしてる子って
traducao: I don't dislike that at all,\ngirls who are clear about what they want.

original: そりゃ光栄ね
traducao: Well, I'm honored.

original: どうもありがと♪
traducao: Thanks a bunch~

original: たまに思うんだけど……
traducao: I think about this sometimes, but...

original: エミルとルカってちょっと似てない？
traducao: Don't Emil and Ruca seem kind of similar?

original: あ〜〜。\n何かわかるかも
traducao: Aaah.\nI can kind of see that.

original: でしょ！？
traducao: Right?!

original: たまに、他人と思えない様な\n気がするっていうか
traducao: Sometimes I feel like\nthey can't be complete strangers.

original: でも、実はそんなに\n似てなかったりするわよ？
traducao: Though honestly, they might not be\nthat similar at all, you know?

original: だって、ルカの方が甘ったれだし\n泣き虫だし優柔不断だしマザコンだし\nガリ勉だし弱腰だし後ろ向きだし〜ぃ
traducao: I mean, Ruca is way more of a spoiled\ncrybaby, indecisive mama's boy, timid\nbookworm, and total pessimist~!

original: そ、そこまで言わなくても……
traducao: Y-You didn't have to go that far......

original: な〜んてね！
traducao: Just kidding!

original: だからこそのルカっていうか、\nいじり甲斐もあるってもんよ♪
traducao: That's what makes Ruca who he is,\nand why teasing him is so much fun~

original: その点、エミルは今後に期待ってヤツね∀
traducao: In that sense, Emil shows potential!

original: はぁ……
traducao: *sigh*...

original: ルカ、元気を出して
traducao: Cheer up, Ruca.

original: 全滅回数が１０回を超えたからって、\nそんなに……
traducao: Just because we wiped out over 10 times,\nyou shouldn't......

original: ……そんなに\nやっぱり色々考えちゃうし、\n落ち込むよね……
traducao: ......Still,\nit makes you overthink things\nand feel depressed, doesn't it......

original: 僕がもっと強かったら……。\nそうしたら、みんなの事も\nちゃんと守れたかもしれないのに……
traducao: If only I were stronger......\nThen I could have protected everyone\nproperly, but......

original: 僕だって……。\nもっと僕に力があったら\nもっともっとみんなの役に立てたかも……
traducao: Me too......\nIf only I had more power,\nI could have been far more useful......

original: だ〜〜〜〜もう！\nウジウジじめじめ、うっとうしいわね！！
traducao: Gaaaah, enough already!\nQuit moping around, it's so annoying!!

original: 済んだ事は済んだ事！\nいつまでも悶々と考えてないで\nこれから出来る事を考えるの！
traducao: What's done is done!\nStop agonizing over the past and think\nabout what you can do from now on!

original: いい！？
traducao: Got it?!

original: はぁ〜、だるいわぁ〜〜……
traducao: Sigh, I'm so sluggish......

original: どーせ掃除したってすぐ汚れるじゃない。\nアホらし。\nねぇ、サボりましょ？
traducao: It just gets dirty again anyway.\nWhat a pain.\nHey, let's slack off!

original: そんな……。\nみんなで当番制にしてるんだから、\n僕らだけサボるなんてダメだよ
traducao: No way...... We all take turns,\nso we can't be the only ones\nto slack off!

original: は〜〜ぁぁ。\n出た出た、優等生のルカちゃま
traducao: Haaah.\nThere he goes, Master Ruca the prig.

original: ルカく〜〜〜ん。\nあたしさ、ちょっと用事\n思い出しちゃった∀
traducao: Ruuuca-kins~\nI just remembered I have\nan urgent errand to run!

original: そんな言い訳ズルイよ。\nみんなだって、やってるんだから
traducao: That's such a cheap excuse.\nEveryone else is doing their part too!

original: ぬっ！\nルカのくせに、生意気な
traducao: Guh!\nPretty cheeky for Ruca!

original: はいはい、やりますよ、\nやればいいんでしょ！
traducao: Fine, fine, I'll do it!\nI just have to do it, right?!

original: 二人で一緒にやれば、\nすぐに終わるよ。\n……ね？
traducao: If we do it together,\nit'll be over in no time.\n......Right?

original: ぷ〜んだ
traducao: Pffft!

original: ちょっとぉ！　\n掃除なんて全然終わんないじゃないの！？
traducao: Hey!\nThis cleaning is never gonna end!!

original: これだけ広いんだもの、さすがに\nそんなすぐには終わらないよ
traducao: It's so huge, of course\nit won't be finished that fast.

original: もう少しだから、頑張ろう
traducao: We're almost done, let's hang in there.

original: ル〜カ〜ちゃま〜∀\nね、じゃんけんしよっか？
traducao: Maaaster Ruuuca~\nWanna play rock-paper-scissors?

original: え……まさか、負けた方が\n残りを全部やるって言うの？
traducao: Eh... Don't tell me the loser\nhas to do the rest all alone?

original: あ〜ら、察しがいいわね。\nほら、３回勝負で行きましょ∀
traducao: My, aren't you sharp?\nCome on, a three-round match!

original: （嫌だって言ったら、\n　また機嫌が悪くなるよね……）
traducao: (If I say no,\nshe'll get in a bad mood again...)

original: （……でも、じゃんけんに\n　勝てばいいんだし……）
traducao: (...Still, all I have to do\nis win at rock-paper-scissors...)

original: う……うん……
traducao: U-Um... yeah......

original: そんじゃ、行くわよ〜。\nじゃ〜んけ〜ん……
traducao: Well then, here goes~!\nRock, paper, scissors......

original: グーッ！！
traducao: ROCK--!!

original: 痛っ！\nそれパンチじゃ……
traducao: Ouch!\nThat was just a punch......

original: ほら、２回戦目、\nじゃ〜んけ〜ん……
traducao: Here comes round two!\nRock, paper, scissors......

original: チョキッ！！
traducao: SCISSORS--!!

original: ひょっと……、ヒ、ヒリア……！\nは、鼻に……、ゆ、ゆひが……
traducao: Whoa... I-Iria...!\nY-Your fingers... in my nose......

original: ほら、最後よ〜〜〜！\nじゃ〜んけ〜ん……
traducao: Here comes the final round~~!\nRock, paper, scissors......

original: パーッ！！
traducao: PAPER--!!

original: うわっ！
traducao: Wah!

original: いっひひ〜。\nこれで、あたしの３戦全勝ね
traducao: Ih-hihi~\nWith that, I won all three rounds!

original: そいじゃ、約束通り、\nあとはヨロシク〜∀
traducao: Well then, as promised,\nI'll leave the rest to you~!

original: うぅ……ひどい……
traducao: Ugh...... That's terrible......

traducao: Normal.\n
